deploy.vercel.notLinked: The project isn't linked to Vercel yet: run `vercel link` in the workspace.
deploy.cloudflare.pagesProject: This is a Cloudflare Pages project; Pages deploys come later. Workers are supported.
deploy.firebase.severalSites: This project has several Hosting sites; one site is supported for now.
deploy.firebase.noDefaultProject: The project has no default Firebase project: run `firebase use --add` in the workspace.
deploy.fly.noAppName: fly.toml has no `app` name: run `fly launch` or set `app` in fly.toml.
deploy.docker.label: Docker image
deploy.docker.noImage: Name the image to push to, e.g. `ghcr.io/you/app`.
deploy.hint.npm: Install it with `npm i -g {{package}}`, then sign in with `{{cli}} login` in a terminal.
deploy.hint.fly: Install flyctl (fly.io/docs/flyctl/install), then sign in with `fly auth login` in a terminal.
deploy.hint.docker: Install Docker (docs.docker.com/get-docker), then sign in to the registry with `docker login <registry>`.
deploy.hint.signIn: Sign in with `{{command}}` in a terminal.
deploy.hint.dockerNotRunning: Docker isn't running. Start it, and sign in to the registry with `docker login <registry>`.
deploy.service.alreadyRunning: A {{label}} deploy is already running in this workspace.
deploy.service.noPreviews: {{label}} has no previews; deploy to production instead.
deploy.service.notSetUp: This workspace isn't set up for {{label}}.
deploy.plan.noCommits: The workspace has no commits yet.
deploy.plan.detached: The workspace isn't on a branch (detached HEAD). Check out the branch to deploy.
deploy.plan.uncommitted: The workspace has uncommitted changes. Production deploys a clean tree: commit or stash them first.
deploy.production.typeName: Type the project's name, {{project}}, to confirm.
deploy.production.branchMoved: The branch has moved since the plan was shown. Check the plan again before deploying.
deploy.rollback.notRecorded: That deploy isn't recorded in this workspace.
deploy.rollback.onlyProduction: Only a production deploy that worked can be rolled back; previews don't take traffic.
deploy.rollback.newerIsLive: A newer production deploy is live. Roll that one back instead.
deploy.rollback.noPrevious: The app has no record of the {{label}} deploy before this one, so there's nothing to go back to here. Roll back in the provider's console.
